# Pull request

## What changed

Describe the change in plain language.

## Why

Explain the problem this solves or the goal it supports.

## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] I tested the changed behavior locally
- [ ] I checked mobile and desktop when the UI changed
- [ ] I added screenshots or a preview link when the UI changed

## GitHub checklist

- [ ] This PR contains one focused change
- [ ] The title says what the change does
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, or unrelated changes are included
- [ ] I read the **Files changed** tab before requesting review
- [ ] All automated checks pass

## Notes for the reviewer

Call out anything confusing, risky, unfinished, or worth checking closely.
